notes.title: Unity Port
notes.content:
Hi!

[i][b]Night and Day[/b][/i] is currently being ported to Unity to make the structure of the game from scratch, since all the attempts at fixing and purging my poor spaghetti code have only led to new bugs. 

The porting process is quite advanced by now, so I think we can have a new version of the game before the summer, keeping the story, the options, and the mini-games, but this time without any hindrance during the gameplay. For those of you who have found a bug that prevented obtaining one of the endings, I can only ask for a bit more patience. No one is looking forward to having [i][b]Night and Day[/b][/i] working at its best as I do, trust me!

Thank you again for your understanding!

notes.title: New update with bug fixes
notes.content:
Hi, it's me again, after so long since the last time I updated[i][b] Night and Day[/b][/i].

First of all, let me apologize for the unreasonable delay in fixing the bugs: I suppose many of you know that my team is basically just myself, plus the amazing artists and composers I commission. I sometimes have a bit of help with the coding, but there isn't any regular programmer on my team,  just consultants. The thing is, I've been playtesting the game again and again for [b]the last year and a half[/b], but my poor spaghetti code seems to be confusing Renpy and, even though my consultants and I couldn't find any bugs, they still appeared every time I pushed a new build of the game -_-  

That's the reason the launch of the game was delayed for a year. I give you all my word that I'll never try to make a stats-raising game again, and even less a stats-raising hybrid like [i][b]Night and Day[/b][/i]: from now on, my games will be classic visual novels, with affection points and perhaps some minigames, but that's all. I don't want to spend months of my life chasing bugs ever again!

That said, the error in [b]Ferdinand's route[/b] that affected the last two weeks of the game (that is, from the moment Paul decides to give himself a deadline of two weeks) [b]is now fixed[/b].

For the rest of the bugs reported... I haven't been able to reproduce them, but I'll keep going over them. If you want to send a save with your error to my email (ertal77@hotmail.com) that would be really, really useful, but of course it's up to you, and I promise to keep working on making [i][b]Night and Day[/b][/i] the best possible BL visual novel it can be.

With love,

Ertal

notes.title: Changelog for version 1.2
notes.content:
Happy New Year's Eve!!

Here's the update I promised, right before the end of the year! I hope all those pesky bugs are now fixed: I'll open a post here on the Steam page, where you can send any other thing you find that needs to be fixed (although let's cross our fingers so that isn't necessary).

I'm not sure if this new version will be compatible with your saves; it should be, but anyway, if you previously found errors in your gameplay, it would be advisable to uninstall the previous version and delete the folder on C/: user/AppData/Roaming/Renpy/NightandDay, before installing the new version 1.2. Remember you can use the "Skip" option to progress quickly to your previous point in the game in case you need to start anew.

Changelog:

- The Open Dyslexic font has been adjusted to the right size so the text always fits the textbox.

- The "return" button on the close-up images of the gallery has been moved to the bottom right corner and simplified to just black letters without a background, so it doesn't distract from the images.

- Added an in-game warning when there are only two weeks left to finish the game (as Paul's internal monologue, to be as little intrusive as possible).

- Removed a potentially offensive sentence.

- Added a short afterscene for Emile's intimate scene.

- Checked all the instances where Ferdinand's route might have inconsistencies after March 9.

- Made the dates screen disappear if the player decides not to select anything.

- Lowered two points in the requirements to successfully join the exhibition.

- Added extra days, April 4th to 9th, so the players have more days to go on dates, give presents, and get all the scenes with the love interest that lead to the good ending.

- Added three minigames.

I think that's all! As you can see, I haven't been idle this past month XDD

notes.title: Update about the current state of the game
notes.content:
Hello, and first of all: Merry Christmas from Ertal Games, for the ones of you who celebrate it!

Let me apologize for the lack of updates of these last months, but now that I've returned to my full-time job, juggling it with family obligations and game developing has proven more testing than I expected. But fear not, the game is steadily worked on, and not dropped at all! I've seen some BL games on Kickstarter going on radio silence lately, but this won't be the case of Night and Day: trust me when I tell you that, when you don't get updates, it's just because I have no energies left after work and coding, but not because we aren't making progress.

About the current state of the game: the art is 100% done, including the mini-game art assets, and all the love interests scenes are also written. What is delaying the production is coding everything together without major bugs: the structure my programmer did for the game ended up being too restrictive for what I wanted in the VN, so very little of it is actually used, so I had to wing it, with the help of the programmer when I get stuck at something.

These latest weeks I've been coding the date scenes, which I think it's a cute addition to the storyline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37562244/b270b527efd79b1b29459c90c1ca403bfb17c895.png[/img]

See you in the next update! I'll try to make it sooner this time, I promise!

notes.content:
The game has been almost finished for a while, but I'm having some issues with the coding that are currently being worked on. And the main script is done, just waiting until the code is fixed and the scenes can be inserted in their place.

The backers who opted for an early access tier will get next week a build of the first four weeks of the game, until the moment you are locked into one of the love interest's routes (which is the code I'll finish fixing within this weekend).

But, for now, let me share with you all the opening video! Original song by Fricochet, featuring MyëVe.

notes.title: Release Delay
notes.content:
Sorry, guys, but the release has been postponed.

The art for the game is 100% finished, the script is 90% done, but the coding is taking more time (and energies) than planned. I can't state a date yet, but please be assured I'm working on Night and Day as hard as I can.

notes.title: Smol Side Project for Yaoi Jam
notes.content:
Hiya! I know many of you are looking forward to[i][b] Night and Day[/b][/i]'s final release... Unfortunately, I'm still in coding hell, and I'll need some weeks more to sort everything out. I prefer not to give a date until I've made sure that everything works as it should, the script is thoroughly edited, and the game has been beta-tested, but I can assure you everyone involved is doing their best.

In August, I took a week off (for my brain's sanity, as the hours of coding variables was driving me insane) to work on a side project: every year, I try to take part in the Yaoi Game Jam, usually making a demo for a future project. This year, since I'm knees deep in [i][b]Night and Day[/b][/i] and the next project is already waiting ([i][b]Deep in the Forest[/b][/i]), I opted for transforming an old pirates AU fanfiction of mine into an original Visual Novel. Hence, I only had to translate the text into English, make a few changes, and voilá! [i][b]Jolly Roger[/b][/i] is served!

The artist for this project is Aielia Poot, who also made a bunch of cutscenes illustrations for [i][b]Night and Day [/b][/i]and is now eager to work on more BL games.

I'll consider bringing Jolly Roger to Steam in the future, but for the moment you can find it on itchio, for free, as all my other jam or short projects. Enjoy!

[h3][url=https://ertal-games.itch.io/jolly-roger]https://ertal-games.itch.io/jolly-roger[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Updated, Extended Demo Available!
notes.content:
While we are making quick progress towards the final release of Night and Day, I think it's time to update the demo and let everyone get a bit more of Paul's story!

[h3]So, what's new in this extended demo:[/h3]

[list]
[*] All the art is finished; that means you'll find five CGs and that all the characters who matter have a face.
[*] 24.5k words.
[*] The first whole week of Paul in Paris: more scenes with Emile, Gilles, and Ferdinand! (Bernard, sadly, only appears a bit later on.) Let's go on dates!
[*] Finished soundtrack.
[*] First skippable mini-game.
[/list]

The text and, especially, some visuals, might change in the final release, depending on your feedback. I would really appreciate it if you could take two minutes to fill in our [b]feedback questionnaire[/b]:
[url=https://forms.gle/GU5SRFrE9yavnf938]https://forms.gle/GU5SRFrE9yavnf938[/url]

Looking forward to hearing what you think, guys!
